## Read in Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(mapview)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(tidytext)
```

```{r}

ag_2015 <- st_read(here("data/Agricultural_Land_Use_2015_Baseline.geojson"))


```

```{r}

ag_2020 <- st_read(here("data/Agricultural_Land_Use_2020_Update.geojson"))

```

## Potential Questions

Histogram of acreage

```{r}
ggplot(data = ag_2015, aes(x = acreage, fill = island)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_classic()

```

crops by island

```{r}
crop_island <- ag_2020 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(island, crops_2020) %>%
  summarize(acres = sum(acreage)) %>%
  filter(crops_2020 != "Pasture", island != "Lanai")

ggplot(crop_island, aes(x = acres, y = reorder(crops_2020, acres, sum))) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  facet_wrap(~island, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = "Acres", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

```

## Make a Map

```{r}
mapview(ag_2015, zcol = "cropcatego")

```

### After looking at our mapview map, the map color scale

## isn't that helpful to us... use r color brewer to change palette

```{r}

mapview(ag_2015, zcol = "cropcatego",
        col.regions = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired")))


```

## Distribution of Acreage

```{r}
ggplot(ag_2020, aes(x = acreage)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "darkgreen", color = "white") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000), labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = "Plot size (acres)", y = "Number of plots") +
  theme_bw()




```

island map of color by crop

```{r}

pcrops <- ag_2020 %>% filter(crops_2020 != "Pasture")

mapview(crops, zcol = "crops_2020",
        col.regions = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired")),
        layer.name = "Crop")

```
